message.content:
I’m sorry, but Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other Model) in India, so there is no official retail price available at this time.  

If Tesla were to enter the Indian market, the price would likely be set after accounting for import duties, taxes, and local market conditions. Based on the current U.S. price of the Model S (roughly $90,000–$100,000) and typical import duty rates in India (which can range from 10 % to 30 % plus GST), a rough estimate would place the Model S somewhere in the **₹1.5 million to ₹2.0 million** range (about **$20,000–$25,000**).  

However, until Tesla announces an official launch and pricing strategy for India, any figure would be purely speculative.
